description: Editorial comparison page with one dense table of 15 phones x 8 columns (model, price, screen, battery, weight, storage, 5G, release year), a repeated header row after row 8, a footnote row spanning all columns, an 'Our picks' box and a deals rail with different prices.

price.description: Launch price in USD from the table; null when not announced

notes: Output is wrapped as {phones: [...]} by the customer schema; gold lists the bare records. The repeated header row and the footnote row are not phones (exactly 15 records). Halcyon P8 price is 'TBA' → null. Battery cells use thousands separators ('5,000'). The picks box ($949 Nova X1 Pro, $179 Orbis A16, $299 Fennec Lite) and the deals rail ($599, $749, $449) are street prices, not launch prices.
